description: Top-of-page hero. Last word of the headline gets an iridescent gradient (teal → violet → magenta → coral). Mantis-shrimp compound-eye motif on the right is rendered by JS based on the page-level data-motif attribute. Three CTAs: primary (filled), secondary (outline), tertiary (ghost).

fields.description: Small all-caps label above the headline. The design uses a colon-space-separated triple, e.g. 'AI-native · kernel-class · mantis-shrimp-fast'.
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.title: Eyebrow

fields.description: Big H1. The LAST WORD gets the gradient — write the headline so the most punchy word ends the sentence. The trailing punctuation (e.g. '.') stays glued to the gradient word.
fields.name: headline
fields.title: Headline

fields.description: 1–2 sentences under the headline. Wrap accent words in <span style="color: var(--accent)"> for the inline highlight.
fields.name: lead
fields.title: Lead paragraph

fields.description: Filled button. The view prepends '$ ' and appends ' →' to the text.
fields.name: primary
fields.title: Primary CTA

fields.description: Outline button. The view appends ' ↗' to the text.
fields.name: secondary
fields.title: Secondary CTA

fields.name: tertiary

name: Squilla Hero

test_data.headline: The CMS where AI does the work.
test_data.lead: Squilla is an open-source, Go-based content management system built around one idea: an AI agent should be able to build, populate, and operate an entire website with zero human intervention. Every operation is exposed as an MCP tool. Every feature lives in a sovereign gRPC extension. The kernel stays small, the system stays fast.
